all_planned_rule: Each mode: exact correct / 8; each other outcome counts zero, including unresolved reference
exact_rule: Correct mechanism and root service plus supporting trace evidence; no symptom-only credit
grouping: Report four candidate groups with two executions each; no independent execution or significance claim
partial_rule: Correct bounded aspect but missing or under-specified mechanism/service/evidence; never exact
primary: Mean paired Cross minus Single exact root cause accuracy
report: Report counts and denominators by mode and group, failures and missing for all scheduled calls; null if denominator zero
scorable_pair: Both fault outputs valid ANALYZED and reference resolved

secondary.cost: priced attempt usage with documented tariff; missing is null
secondary.exact_accuracy: exact correct / scorable fault outputs in eligible pairs
secondary.latency: per attempted call with observed latency; report coverage
secondary.mechanism_accuracy: correct component / scorable analyzed fault outputs with resolved component
secondary.normal_false_attribution_rate: false fault attribution / scorable analyzed Normal outputs
secondary.propagation_handling_accuracy: correct handling / scorable analyzed fault outputs with resolved handling
secondary.root_service_accuracy: correct service / scorable analyzed fault outputs with reference service
secondary.token_usage: per attempt with provider usage; report coverage
secondary.unsupported_claim_rate: unsupported or hallucinated / all scorable claims, including uncited claims if scorable
